text: Giorgi Sharashidze - What kind of deputy prime ministership and state minister position are we talking about? They won’t even give him a proper office; he won’t have an apparatus, and he won’t even have a secretary. I would advise Mdinaradze not to get too fixated on this office either and to work remotely (28.04.2026, 12:04)

“What kind of vice-premiership and state minister position are we talking about? They’re not even giving him a proper office; he won’t even have a staff or a secretary. I would advise Mdinaradze not to get too fixated on this office either and to work remotely from home,” said Giorgi Sharashidze, a member of the “Gakharia for Georgia” party, while speaking about the creation of the position of State Minister for coordinating law enforcement agencies. According to him, appointing a general coordinator will change nothing except that it will be his “temporary appeasement and sending him into retirement.”

“The planned changes have nothing to do with solving the problems of our country’s citizens or the issues of Georgia’s security. This is yet another manifestation of informal governance. ‘Dream’ and the 89 MPs sitting in parliament have no purpose other than to simply ‘justify’ Ivanishvili’s decisions, which no one consults them about. What vice-premiership and state minister position are we talking about? They are not even giving him a proper office; he won’t have an administration, and Mdinaradze won’t even have a secretary. I would advise him not to get too fixated on this office either and to work remotely from home instead.”

If coordination is so important, then the head of the State Security Service is not dismissed after six months for the sake of coordination. The State Security Service is not appointed for a six-year term by accident — this provision is not in the law by accident. We can see that in the past year alone, two heads of the State Security Service have already been replaced. This indicates an unstable environment and informal governance. A person was granted the rank of general in the morning and demoted to coordinator in the evening on the very same day — what special expectations should we have from such a person?

As for the coordinator role, it was the “Dream” party itself that introduced this term, and yesterday one of our leaders, Giga Farulava, at the session of the Legal Committee, when he stated the fact that you are appointing a coordinator, it caused such irritation that they criticized his choice of words and tone. This coordinator is a term introduced by “Dream,” and if it is offensive to them, then they should explain where they got this term from in the first place. Therefore, when we say that this appointment of a general coordinator will change nothing except that it will simply be some kind of temporary appeasement and a sending-off into retirement, that is the reality,” Sharashidze said.

For your information, Parliament is considering, under an expedited procedure, a draft law on the basis of which the position of State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies is being introduced within the composition of the Government of Georgia.
According to the project, the Government Administration will provide the new State Minister’s activities with material-technical and organizational support.

According to Vakhtang Bachiashvili, the Parliamentary Secretary of the Government, the powers of the State Minister will be clarified in a government resolution, where his routine and strategic responsibilities will be specified.
Mamuka Mdinaradze will be appointed to the position of State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies.
